hdr.name: Hard Rock Hotel Los Cabos
hdr.city: Cabo San Lucas, Baja California Sur, Mexico

flags: Venue abroad (Mexico): no price from the venue yet. Our Bay Area price sheet does not apply abroad, so every line shows unknown until the venue or a local supplier gives a price.
Capacity not stated: ask the venue. The guest slider runs to 1,000.

notes.t: From the venue's documents: diamond package early planning usd: $1,000 (via travel agent Here & Away)
May 2027 rooms from $631 per night for 2 adults (agent figure)
Late-night bars open until 2 am Thursday to Saturday
Beach is not swimmable; guests sign a waiver
Agent says the resort offers wedding and room concessions

Website check: Site gives no maximum guest count: 'Each of our collections allows up to 32 guests' is a package base (extra guests can be added), NOT capacity. Event space: '60,000 square feet of meeting and event space'.
Website check: Site fees: outside vendor fee $1,500 per vendor; guest day passes 2025 $192 adult / $116 child.
Website check: Agent facts (rooms from $631/night, bars to 2 am, beach not swimmable) are not on the checked pages; kept as agent figures.
Website check: Coordinates from OpenStreetMap ('Hard Rock Hotel Los Cabos - All Inclusive, Diamonte Boulevard', 23473).
Lounge open to 1 am Sun-Wed and 2 am Thu-Sat; outdoor bar to midnight (via travel agent Here & Away)
Wedding planning (and venue choice) starts 6 months before; Diamond Package $1,000 to start planning earlier (via travel agent Here & Away)
Concessions by room-block size include free events and room nights (via travel agent Here & Away)
45 minutes from Los Cabos (SJD) airport (via travel agent Here & Away)
8 restaurants on site (via travel agent Here & Away)
